basic_info.description: Welcome to the essence of San Francisco architecture through this beautifully crafted full floor Edwardian condominium. Featuring three bedrooms, one bathroom, original restored hardwood floors, and a private deck for entertaining with serene outlooks, this period masterpiece captures the enduring romance of San Francisco's golden age while offering all the comforts of modern living, enhanced for the demands of a contemporary, luxury urban lifestyle. Nestled in the heart of San Francisco, the Lower Haight/Hayes Valley and Alamo Square district blends historic charm with modern sophistication, making it a premier destination for luxury living. Iconic Victorian architecture, including the famed Painted Ladies, pairs beautifully with a vibrant cultural scene, boutique shopping, and gourmet dining. Just minutes from downtown, this neighborhood offers a rare combination of tranquility, prestige, and city accessperfect for buyers seeking timeless elegance with a contemporary edge.
